June 19, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Douglass Winthrop Advisors Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 13.92% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Douglass Winthrop Advisors Llc bought 61,059 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 499,640 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $83.83 million, up from 438,581 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Douglass Winthrop Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $927.68 billion market cap company. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
